name: Open-front picking bin 145 x 100 x 80 mm
description:
The smallest open-front picking bin in the Israeli range, the shelf-mounted parts bin used for screws, fittings and electronic components. The front wall stands at roughly 40% of the back wall's height with the side walls sweeping down between them on a curve, so an operator can reach in without lifting the bin off the shelf.

External dimensions: depth 145 mm, width 100 mm, height 80 mm.

No dimensional standard governs this family; sizes are manufacturer-specific. These three are typical of the commonly stocked small/medium/large range.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 1,116 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
summary: Open-front picking bin, extra small - 145 x 100 x 80 mm true-scale GLB of a standard shelf/parts bin for small-parts storage.
